svg.title: Circular-economy effects on European production: separate steel routes

cc:Work.dc:title: Circular-economy effects on European production: separate steel routes
cc:Work.dc:description: European production responses to medium/high EU-only CE in 2050, with NDC above NDC+LTT. Columns show cement, primary iron and steel, secondary iron and steel, and aluminium. Each category pairs OMNIA-ENGAGE solid bars on the left with GCAM hatched bars on the right. Every value is 100 × (CE output − no-CE output) / no-CE output for the same model, climate pathway, geography, production category and year. Primary and secondary steel use their own route-specific no-CE production in the denominator, not total steel production. These are output changes, not changes in route shares or percentage-point contributions, and the two route percentages are not additive. OMNIA selects Production|Iron and Steel|Primary and Production|Iron and Steel|Secondary; GCAM selects Production|Iron and Steel|Steel|Primary and Production|Iron and Steel|Steel|Secondary. All production source units are Mt/yr. A source check compares GCAM's primary-plus-secondary sum with its reported steel parent for each selected scenario and year, without filling missing GCAM values with zero. Cement excludes clinker. Aluminium retains OMNIA primary-plus-secondary output and GCAM's reported aluminium output; GCAM aluminium route coverage remains unconfirmed. Cement and aluminium responses equal those in Figure 1. All eight panels share a percentage scale; signed increases and decreases are retained. Markers identify observed values, including zero; labels round to 0.1% while bar coordinates and CSV values retain full precision. Unavailable, nonfinite or nonpositive no-CE references give gaps. OMNIA no-CE secondary steel is blank in all three EU regions under NDC+LTT. Its configured provisional zero treatment yields a zero route reference; the percentage remains undefined, as it does when the blanks are preserved, and no OMNIA response is drawn in panel g. Normalisation focuses on within-model CE responses and does not establish agreement in absolute production or energy levels, or harmonise the models' process boundaries. Historical bars are omitted because these are matched-year CE contrasts. OMNIA sums EUE, EUM and EUW; GCAM selects its EU-27 aggregate once. The OMNIA regions include some small non-EU countries and territories. Only medium/high CE applied in the EU enters; EU+ cases are excluded. Raw source quantities, reference totals, exact variables, regions and calculation coefficients accompany every result. A missing, nonfinite or nonpositive reference makes the response undefined.

g.text: Reference: each model's own 2050 no-CE output in the same pathway and production category (0%).

g.text: Primary and secondary steel each use their own route reference. These percentage changes are not additive.
